import hashlib,json,os,stat,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
started=time.monotonic()
p=Path.home()/"steganography-gpu/.benchmark/png-bmp-generated-control-20261028"
root,out=p/"worktree",p/"output"
packet=json.loads(input())
props_keys=("MainPID","ActiveState","SubState","Result","ExecMainStatus","MemoryMax","MemorySwapMax","RuntimeMaxUSec","Restart","KillMode","KillSignal","ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic","ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic","MemoryPeak","ControlGroup")
env={**os.environ,"XDG_RUNTIME_DIR":"/run/user/1000","DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS":"unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus"}
run=subprocess.run(["systemctl","--user","show","png-bmp-generated-control-20261028.service",*["--property="+k for k in props_keys]],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=10)
props=dict(line.split("=",1) for line in run.stdout.splitlines())
assert props["MainPID"]=="0" and props["SubState"]=="exited" and props["ExecMainStatus"]=="0"
folder=Path("/sys/fs/cgroup")/props.pop("ControlGroup").lstrip("/")
kernel={name:(folder/name).read_text().strip() for name in ("memory.peak","memory.max","memory.swap.current","memory.swap.max","memory.events","cgroup.procs")}
assert kernel["cgroup.procs"]==""
assert int(kernel["memory.max"])==8*1024**3 and kernel["memory.swap.max"]=="0" and kernel["memory.swap.current"]=="0"
assert all(int(line.split()[1])==0 for line in kernel["memory.events"].splitlines() if line.split()[0] in ("max","oom","oom_kill","oom_group_kill"))
assert props["Restart"]=="no" and props["RuntimeMaxUSec"]=="30min"
def digest(path):
    assert not any(x.is_symlink() for x in (path,*path.parents))
    assert stat.S_ISREG(path.stat().st_mode)
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(4*1024**2),b""):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()
for name,expected in packet.items():
    assert digest(root/name)==expected
worker=json.loads((out/"worker.json").read_text())
decision=json.loads((out/"decision.json").read_text())
assert decision["status"]=="passed_generated_only" and decision["confirmed_updates_lower_bound"]==1616
checks=[]
for phase,rows in (("profile",worker["profiles"]),("control",worker["fits"])):
    for row in rows:
        saved=row["checkpoint"];name=f"{phase}-{row['cell']}.numeric"
        assert saved["name"]==name and (out/name).stat().st_size==saved["bytes"]
        assert digest(out/name)==saved["sha256"]
        checks.append({"name":name,"sha256":saved["sha256"],"bytes":saved["bytes"]})
assert len(checks)==8
files={str(path.relative_to(out)):digest(path) for path in out.rglob("*") if path.is_file()}
all_paths=[path for path in p.rglob("*") if path.is_file()]
assert not any(path.is_symlink() for path in p.rglob("*"))
logical=sum(path.stat().st_size for path in all_paths)
allocated=sum(path.stat().st_blocks*512 for path in all_paths)
assert logical<=512*1024**2 and allocated<=512*1024**2
execution_seconds=(int(props["ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic"])-int(props["ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic"]))/1e6
assert 0<execution_seconds<=1800
print(json.dumps({"schema":"spatial-generated-independent-closing-v1","status":"passed_remote_closing_integrity","properties":props,"kernel":kernel,"source_files_verified":len(packet),"checkpoints":checks,"output_file_sha256":files,"phase_logical_bytes_including_staged_inputs":logical,"phase_allocated_bytes_including_staged_inputs":allocated,"kernel_execution_seconds":execution_seconds,"audit_seconds":time.monotonic()-started,"conservative_elapsed_through_remote_audit_seconds":time.monotonic()-int(props["ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic"])/1e6,"real_fit_authorized":False},sort_keys=True))

props_keys=("MainPID","ActiveState","SubState","Result","ExecMainStatus","MemoryMax","MemorySwapMax","RuntimeMaxUSec","Restart","KillMode","KillSignal","ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic","ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic","MemoryPeak","ControlGroup")

    h=hashlib.sha256()

        for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(4*1024**2),b""):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()

checks=[]
for phase,rows in (("profile",worker["profiles"]),("control",worker["fits"])):
    for row in rows:
        saved=row["checkpoint"];name=f"{phase}-{row['cell']}.numeric"
        assert saved["name"]==name and (out/name).stat().st_size==saved["bytes"]
        assert digest(out/name)==saved["sha256"]
        checks.append({"name":name,"sha256":saved["sha256"],"bytes":saved["bytes"]})
assert len(checks)==8
files={str(path.relative_to(out)):digest(path) for path in out.rglob("*") if path.is_file()}
all_paths=[path for path in p.rglob("*") if path.is_file()]
assert not any(path.is_symlink() for path in p.rglob("*"))
logical=sum(path.stat().st_size for path in all_paths)
allocated=sum(path.stat().st_blocks*512 for path in all_paths)
assert logical<=512*1024**2 and allocated<=512*1024**2
execution_seconds=(int(props["ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic"])-int(props["ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic"]))/1e6
assert 0<execution_seconds<=1800
print(json.dumps({"schema":"spatial-generated-independent-closing-v2","status":"passed_remote_closing_integrity","properties":props,"kernel":kernel,"source_files_verified":len(packet),"checkpoints":checks,"output_file_sha256":files,"phase_logical_bytes_including_staged_inputs":logical,"phase_allocated_bytes_including_staged_inputs":allocated,"kernel_execution_seconds":execution_seconds,"audit_seconds":time.monotonic()-started,"conservative_elapsed_through_remote_audit_seconds":time.monotonic()-int(props["ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic"])/1e6,"real_fit_authorized":False},sort_keys=True))

"""Read-only independent event/anchor/score audit; no optimizer or GPU calls."""
import hashlib
import json
import math
import time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from core import colab_artifacts as a
from core import spatial_control as c
from core import spatial_control_io as transport

started=time.monotonic()
root=Path.cwd(); base=root/'.benchmark/png-bmp-generated-control-20261028'; out=base/'output'
remote=json.loads((base/'closing-v2-stdout.json').read_text())
worker=a.document(out/'worker.json'); decision=a.document(out/'decision.json')
contract,binding,corpus=c.load(root,root/'benchmarks/png-bmp-generated-control-protocol-20261028.json')
assert binding==worker['protocol_sha256']==decision['protocol_sha256']
current={name:c.checksum(root/name) for name in c.sources(root)}
assert current==json.loads((base/'qa-source-start.json').read_text())
copied={p.relative_to(out).as_posix():c.checksum(p) for p in out.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
for name,sha in copied.items():
    assert remote['output_file_sha256'][name]==sha
not_copied=set(remote['output_file_sha256'])-set(copied)
assert not_copied=={r['name'] for r in remote['checkpoints']}|{'stdout.log','stderr.log'}

previous='0'*64; last_time=0.; intents=updates=0
state={'phase':'transport','intents':0,'confirmed_updates':0,'last_sha256':previous}
anchors={a.digest(a.encode(state))}; commits={}; losses={}
for path in sorted((out/'events').iterdir()):
    row=a.document(path); commit='result' in row; sequence=updates+1
    phase='profile' if sequence<=16 else 'control'
    offset=sequence-1 if phase=='profile' else sequence-17
    length=4 if phase=='profile' else 400
    cell,step=divmod(offset,length);step+=1
    kind='2-commit' if commit else '1-intent'
    assert path.name==f'{sequence:06d}-{kind}.json'
    assert (row['phase'],row['cell'],row['step'],row['sequence'],row['previous_sha256'])==(phase,cell,step,sequence,previous)
    assert math.isfinite(row['monotonic']) and row['monotonic']>=last_time
    last_time=row['monotonic']
    if commit:
        assert intents==updates+1
        record=row['result']
        assert record['optimizer_updates']==step and record['presentations']==8*step
        assert math.isfinite(record['loss']) and record['loss']>=0
        losses.setdefault((phase,cell),[]).append(record['loss']);updates+=1
    else:
        assert intents==updates;intents+=1
    commits[(sequence,commit)]=row['monotonic']
    previous=copied[path.relative_to(out).as_posix()]
    state={'phase':phase,'intents':intents,'confirmed_updates':updates,'last_sha256':previous}
    anchors.add(a.digest(a.encode(state)))
state['phase']='completed';anchors.add(a.digest(a.encode(state)))
assert updates==intents==1616 and previous==decision['last_sha256']
observations=[json.loads(line) for line in (out/'parent-observations.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
assert all(row['worker_progress_sha256'] is None or row['worker_progress_sha256'] in anchors for row in observations)
assert all(0<row['elapsed_seconds']<=1800 and 0<=row['bytes']<=c.MAX_OUTPUT for row in observations)
assert all(left['monotonic']<=right['monotonic'] for left,right in zip(observations,observations[1:]))

checks=[]
for row in worker['fits']:
    cell=row['cell'];assert row['losses']==losses[('control',cell)]
    result={'cell':cell,'mode':c.CELLS[cell][0],'seed':c.CELLS[cell][1]}
    for stage in ('initial','final'):
        for split,count in (('train',80),('development',24)):
            scores=row[stage][split]
            assert len(scores)==count and all(len(pair)==2 and all(math.isfinite(v) and 0<=v<=1 for v in pair) for pair in scores)
            value=math.fsum(1. if positive[1]>negative[0] else .5 if positive[1]==negative[0] else 0. for negative in scores for positive in scores)/(count*count)
            assert abs(value-decision['cells'][cell][stage+'_'+split])<=1e-12
            result[stage+'_'+split]=value
    first=math.fsum(row['losses'][:20])/20; last=math.fsum(row['losses'][-20:])/20
    assert result['final_train']>=.85 and result['final_development']>=.70 and last<=.8*first
    result.update(first_epoch_loss=first,last_epoch_loss=last,loss_ratio=last/first,
                  optimizer_and_receipt_span_seconds=commits[(416+400*cell,True)]-commits[(17+400*cell,False)])
    checks.append(result)
proof=transport.verify(out/'images',a.document(out/'images/manifest.json'),corpus)
assert proof==worker['transport_checks']==decision['transport_checks']
assert decision['status']=='passed_generated_only' and decision['checkpoints_verified']==8
answer={'schema':'spatial-generated-independent-local-audit-v1','status':'passed_generated_only',
        'protocol_sha256':binding,'source_inputs_verified':len(current),'copied_files_verified':len(copied),
        'numeric_files_stay_on_wsl_verified_by_remote_sha256':8,'events':3232,'confirmed_updates':updates,
        'parent_observations_verified':len(observations),'all_parent_progress_anchors_replayed':True,
        'independent_pairwise_auc_replays':16,'cells':checks,'transport':proof,
        'output_manifest_sha256':a.digest(a.encode(remote['output_file_sha256'])),
        'local_audit_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'real_fit_authorized':False,
        'native_media_opened':False,'historical_budgets_reset':False}
a.put(base/'independent-local-audit.json',a.encode(answer))
print(json.dumps(answer))
